invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null iterator, either via JavaLazyInsertIterable or super.handleInsert.
idPfx is directly passed as an argument and used in downstream calls; it is required for correct record insertion.
recordItr is always passed to the returned iterable or to super.handleInsert, so it should not be null.
Iterator<List<WriteStatus>> produces elements which are Lists, if any.
If canIndexLogFiles is true, the result must be a JavaLazyInsertIterable.
